front_blocks.md: Balanced diet

back_blocks.md: A diet containing all the food groups in the correct proportions to keep the body healthy.

front_blocks.md: List the components of a balanced diet and what each is needed for.

back_blocks.md: Carbohydrates — for energy.
Proteins — for growth and repair.
Lipids (fats and oils) — for energy and insulation.
Vitamins and minerals — to keep the body healthy.
Fibre — to help food move through the gut.
Water — for chemical reactions and transport.

front_blocks.md: What causes scurvy and what are its symptoms?

back_blocks.md: Caused by a lack of vitamin C.
Symptoms include bleeding gums and poor wound healing.

front_blocks.md: What causes rickets and what is its effect?

back_blocks.md: Caused by a lack of vitamin D (or calcium).
Leads to soft, weak bones that bend (e.g. bowed legs).

front_blocks.md: Why is physical digestion important?

back_blocks.md: It increases the surface area of the food, so enzymes can act on it faster during chemical digestion.

front_blocks.md: Give two examples of physical digestion in the body.

back_blocks.md: Chewing of food by the teeth in the mouth.
Churning of food by the muscular wall of the stomach.

front_blocks.md: What are the roles of hydrochloric acid in the stomach (Extended)?

Provides the acidic pH (about pH 2) that is the optimum for the protease enzyme pepsin.
